# Choosing a chart

*Describes silverpoint 0.8.0.*

Choose a chart in two steps. First name the shape of the rows, then name what the reader is asked to
see. The recommender (`recommend_chart` on the MCP server) reads the table below. It is a reviewed
table, not a model, and a pair that is missing from it falls back on the charts that declare both.

## Data shapes

| Shape | The rows hold | For example |
|---|---|---|
| `series` | one row per point along an ordered x (time, sequence) | hits per hour |
| `categories` | one row per category with one or more values | revenue by region |
| `parts` | shares of one whole | traffic by channel |
| `matrix` | a value per pair of categories | errors by day and hour |
| `hierarchy` | one row per node, with an `id` and its `parent` (`null` for the root) | a budget by department |
| `links` | rows with a source, a target and a value | signup funnel steps |
| `points` | two or more numeric measures per row | price against rating |
| `distribution` | many raw observations of one measure | response times |
| `intervals` | a start and an end per row | task schedule |
| `events` | dated occurrences, or marks along a cycle | commits per day |
| `single` | one figure, perhaps with a target | revenue this month |
| `field` | a measure or a vector (`x`, `y`, `u`, `v`) over a plane | a wind field |

## The charts by shape and intent

| Chart | Family | Shape | Intents | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `line-chart` | lines | `series` | trend, change, compare | Spline with an optional dotted baseline series. |
| `bullet-chart` | bars | `categories` | progress, kpi, compare | One bar per target, with a marker at the target. Values in 0-100. |
| `pyramid-chart` | bars | `categories` | rank, compare | Stacked tiers whose width encodes the value (0-100). |
| `heatmap-chart` | points-grids | `matrix` | compare, distribution | Labelled rows of values, normalised against `scaleMax`. |
| `treemap-chart` | points-grids | `parts` | part-to-whole | Tiles of `cols × rows` cells placed in a `columns × rows` grid. |
| `sankey-chart` | flows | `links` | flow, part-to-whole | Flow bands between layered nodes. |
| `activity-grid` | points-grids | `events` | schedule, trend | One cell per day, a column per week. |
| `step-chart` | lines | `series` | trend, change | A series drawn as steps. |
| `sparkline-rows` | lines | `series` | trend, compare, kpi | One row per series — name, sparkline, readout. |
| `kpi-card` | lines | `single` | kpi, change | A metric, its delta, and an area sparkline of the series. |
| `bar-chart` | bars | `categories` | compare, rank | Pill bars, as columns or rows, with an optional second series. |
| `stacked-bar-chart` | bars | `categories` | compare, part-to-whole | One stacked segment per key. |
| `composed-chart` | bars | `series` | compare, trend | Columns and a spline on one value scale. |
| `waterfall-chart` | bars | `categories` | change, part-to-whole | Totals from zero and floating deltas from the running total. |
| `funnel-chart` | bars | `categories` | progress, compare | Horizontal, centred stages. |
| `candlestick-chart` | bars | `intervals` | change, trend | OHLC bodies and wicks. |
| `area-chart` | areas | `series` | trend, change | A curved, toned area under its line. |
| `range-band-chart` | areas | `intervals` | uncertainty, trend | The band between a low and a high series. |
| `stream-chart` | areas | `series` | trend, part-to-whole, compare | Two waves, overlaid or stacked. |
| `scatter-chart` | points-grids | `points` | correlation, distribution | Points on two linear scales, optionally sized. |
| `bubble-chart` | points-grids | `points` | correlation, compare | Circles whose area encodes `sizeKey`. |
| `donut-chart` | radial | `parts` | part-to-whole | Sectors ∝ value around a central readout. |
| `radar-chart` | radial | `categories` | compare | One spoke per subject, a closed polygon of values. |
| `polar-bar-chart` | radial | `categories` | compare, rank | 360° bars out from a hole, length ∝ value. |
| `radial-arc-group` | radial | `categories` | compare, progress | Concentric 180° tracks, sweep ∝ value / the largest. |
| `radial-rings` | radial | `categories` | progress | Concentric progress rings, sweep ∝ value in 0-100. |
| `gauge-arc` | radial | `single` | kpi, progress | A 240° arc swept to a percent. |
| `meter-chart` | radial | `single` | kpi, progress | A semicircular meter with a needle at a percent. |
| `coxcomb-chart` | radial | `categories` | compare, part-to-whole | Equal angles, sector area ∝ value. |
| `wind-rose` | radial | `distribution` | distribution | Observations of (bearing, speed) binned by compass sector and speed. |
| `volvelle-chart` | radial | `categories` | schedule, compare | Concentric categorical rings read against one index. |
| `chord-ring` | flows | `links` | flow, network | Directed flows between categories around a circle. |
| `orbit-chart` | radial | `events` | schedule | Nested elliptical orbits with markers along them. |
| `histogram-chart` | distributions-comparisons | `distribution` | distribution | Raw observations binned in the core. |
| `ecdf-chart` | distributions-comparisons | `distribution` | distribution, compare | The empirical cumulative distribution as a step function. |
| `box-plot-chart` | distributions-comparisons | `distribution` | distribution, compare | Quartiles, median, Tukey whiskers and outliers per group. |
| `violin-chart` | distributions-comparisons | `distribution` | distribution, compare | A mirrored kernel density per group. |
| `ridgeline-chart` | distributions-comparisons | `distribution` | distribution, compare, change | A kernel density per group on overlapping baselines. |
| `beeswarm-chart` | distributions-comparisons | `distribution` | distribution | One point per observation, packed without overlap. |
| `lollipop-chart` | distributions-comparisons | `categories` | compare, rank | A stem from the baseline and a head at the value. |
| `dumbbell-chart` | distributions-comparisons | `categories` | change, compare | Two values per category joined by a segment. |
| `slope-chart` | distributions-comparisons | `categories` | change, rank | Two period axes, one segment per category. |
| `bump-chart` | distributions-comparisons | `series` | rank, change | The rank of each series at each x. |
| `error-bar-chart` | distributions-comparisons | `intervals` | uncertainty, compare | A point estimate with its interval per category. |
| `interval-chart` | distributions-comparisons | `intervals` | schedule | Floating bars from start to end on lanes. |
| `diverging-bar-chart` | distributions-comparisons | `parts` | part-to-whole, compare | Ordered levels stacked on both sides of a neutral centre. |
| `connected-scatter-chart` | distributions-comparisons | `points` | correlation, change | An ordered path through x-y points. |
| `waffle-chart` | hierarchies-dimensions | `parts` | part-to-whole, progress | A unit grid filled in reading order by category. |
| `marimekko-chart` | hierarchies-dimensions | `matrix` | part-to-whole, compare | Column width by total, segment height by share. |
| `squarified-treemap` | hierarchies-dimensions | `hierarchy` | hierarchy, part-to-whole | Nested rectangles, area by value, drillable through `rootId` and `onRootChange`. |
| `sunburst-chart` | hierarchies-dimensions | `hierarchy` | hierarchy, part-to-whole | A hierarchy as rings of arcs, drillable through `rootId` and `onRootChange`. |
| `tree-chart` | hierarchies-dimensions | `hierarchy` | hierarchy | A tidy node-link tree. |
| `parallel-coordinates-chart` | hierarchies-dimensions | `matrix` | correlation, compare | One polyline per row across parallel axes. |
| `polar-line-chart` | hierarchies-dimensions | `series` | trend, compare | A line over angle and radius. |
| `polar-scatter-chart` | hierarchies-dimensions | `points` | distribution, correlation | Points over angle and radius. |
| `density-bin-chart` | fields-networks | `points` | distribution, correlation | X-y points counted in two-dimensional bins. |
| `contour-chart` | fields-networks | `points` | distribution, correlation | Iso-lines and filled bands of a density or a grid. |
| `delaunay-chart` | fields-networks | `points` | network, distribution | The triangulation of x-y points, or its Voronoi cells. |
| `vector-field-chart` | fields-networks | `field` | flow | An arrow per grid point. |
| `network-chart` | fields-networks | `links` | network, flow | A node-link graph. |

## The recommender's table

The scores run from 0 to 1. An adjustment applies when the row count (`rows`) or the number of
value columns (`values`) passes its bound.

| Shape | Intent | Charts, best first | Adjustments |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series` | `trend` | `line-chart` 0.9 — A line is the plainest reading of a value over an ordered axis.<br>`area-chart` 0.8 — An area gives one series the weight of its magnitude.<br>`step-chart` 0.6 — Steps show a value that holds until it changes.<br>`stream-chart` 0.5 — Several value columns overlay or stack as waves.<br>`polar-line-chart` 0.3 — A cyclic axis (hours, months, degrees) closes the line around a circle. | values>1: `stream-chart` +0.3 — Several value fields read together as streams.<br>values>1: `area-chart` -0.2 — An area draws one series only. |
| `series` | `change` | `line-chart` 0.8 — The slope between points is the change.<br>`step-chart` 0.75 — Steps mark when the value changed and by how much.<br>`area-chart` 0.6 — An area shows the change in magnitude.<br>`bump-chart` 0.5 — When the change that matters is in rank. |  |
| `series` | `compare` | `line-chart` 0.8 — A second series draws as a dotted baseline against the first.<br>`composed-chart` 0.75 — Columns and a line share one value scale.<br>`stream-chart` 0.6 — Several series overlaid on one axis.<br>`sparkline-rows` 0.55 — One small line per series, side by side with its readout.<br>`polar-line-chart` 0.3 — Values around a cycle compared by angle. |  |
| `series` | `rank` | `bump-chart` 0.9 — The rank of each series at each x, ranks joined across x. |  |
| `series` | `kpi` | `sparkline-rows` 0.85 — One row per series: its name, its trend and its latest readout.<br>`kpi-card` 0.75 — One metric, its delta and its trend. |  |
| `series` | `part-to-whole` | `stream-chart` 0.8 — Stacked waves show each part of a total over x. |  |
| `categories` | `compare` | `bar-chart` 0.9 — Bars compare values against one common baseline.<br>`lollipop-chart` 0.75 — A lighter mark per category, readable with many of them.<br>`radar-chart` 0.5 — Spokes compare a few subjects at once.<br>`polar-bar-chart` 0.4 — Bars around a circle, for a cyclic set of categories.<br>`coxcomb-chart` 0.35 — Equal angles, area by value: cyclic categories such as months.<br>`radial-arc-group` 0.3 — Concentric tracks, each swept by its value. | rows>12: `lollipop-chart` +0.2 — Many categories read better as lollipops.<br>rows>12: `radar-chart` -0.3 — Radial layouts crowd past a dozen categories.<br>rows>12: `polar-bar-chart` -0.3 — Radial layouts crowd past a dozen categories.<br>rows>12: `coxcomb-chart` -0.3 — Radial layouts crowd past a dozen categories.<br>values>1: `bar-chart` +0.05 — A second value field draws as a second series of bars. |
| `categories` | `rank` | `bar-chart` 0.85 — Sorted bars read as a ranking.<br>`lollipop-chart` 0.85 — Lollipops sort themselves with `sort`.<br>`pyramid-chart` 0.5 — Stacked tiers, widest at the base.<br>`polar-bar-chart` 0.4 — A ranking around a circle. |  |
| `categories` | `part-to-whole` | `stacked-bar-chart` 0.85 — Each bar stacks its parts, one segment per value column.<br>`waterfall-chart` 0.6 — Parts that add up to a running total.<br>`coxcomb-chart` 0.4 — Sectors whose area is each part. |  |
| `categories` | `change` | `dumbbell-chart` 0.9 — Two values per category joined by a segment: before and after.<br>`slope-chart` 0.85 — Two period axes, one segment per category: the slope is the change.<br>`waterfall-chart` 0.75 — Each step a delta from the running total. |  |
| `categories` | `progress` | `bullet-chart` 0.9 — Each bar against its own target.<br>`radial-rings` 0.75 — Concentric rings, each swept to its percent.<br>`funnel-chart` 0.7 — Stages that narrow, such as a conversion.<br>`radial-arc-group` 0.5 — Tracks swept relative to the largest. |  |
| `categories` | `kpi` | `bullet-chart` 0.8 — Each measure against its target, compact.<br>`radial-rings` 0.6 — A few percents at a glance. |  |
| `parts` | `part-to-whole` | `donut-chart` 0.9 — A ring reads a few shares of one whole around a central figure.<br>`waffle-chart` 0.85 — Unit cells make the shares countable.<br>`treemap-chart` 0.7 — Tiles sized by share.<br>`diverging-bar-chart` 0.4 — For ordered levels (agree… disagree) around a neutral centre.<br>`stacked-bar-chart` 0.35 — One bar stacked with the shares, to set beside other wholes. | rows>6: `donut-chart` -0.3 — A ring loses its shares past six slices.<br>rows>6: `treemap-chart` +0.1 — Tiles hold many shares better than a ring. |
| `parts` | `compare` | `diverging-bar-chart` 0.8 — Likert-style levels on both sides of a neutral centre, row by row.<br>`waffle-chart` 0.6 — Countable cells per part. |  |
| `parts` | `progress` | `waffle-chart` 0.8 — A hundred cells filled to the share done. |  |
| `matrix` | `compare` | `heatmap-chart` 0.9 — One toned cell per row and column.<br>`marimekko-chart` 0.7 — Columns by total, segments by share.<br>`parallel-coordinates-chart` 0.6 — One polyline per row across many dimensions. |  |
| `matrix` | `part-to-whole` | `marimekko-chart` 0.9 — Each column a whole, each segment its share, column width by total. |  |
| `matrix` | `correlation` | `parallel-coordinates-chart` 0.9 — Crossing lines between axes show how dimensions move together.<br>`heatmap-chart` 0.6 — A grid of values, read for patterns. |  |
| `matrix` | `distribution` | `heatmap-chart` 0.8 — Where the high values gather in the grid. |  |
| `hierarchy` | `hierarchy` | `tree-chart` 0.85 — The structure itself, node by node.<br>`squarified-treemap` 0.8 — Nested rectangles, drillable.<br>`sunburst-chart` 0.75 — Rings of arcs, one ring per level, drillable. |  |
| `hierarchy` | `part-to-whole` | `squarified-treemap` 0.9 — Area by value, nested by level.<br>`sunburst-chart` 0.85 — Each arc its share of its parent. |  |
| `links` | `flow` | `sankey-chart` 0.9 — Bands between layered stages, width by value.<br>`chord-ring` 0.75 — Flows between categories around a circle, both ways.<br>`network-chart` 0.5 — When the links matter more than their volume. |  |
| `links` | `network` | `network-chart` 0.9 — Nodes and links laid out by a seeded force.<br>`chord-ring` 0.7 — Who connects to whom, around a circle. |  |
| `links` | `part-to-whole` | `sankey-chart` 0.8 — How a total splits and merges across stages. |  |
| `points` | `correlation` | `scatter-chart` 0.9 — Points on two linear scales.<br>`bubble-chart` 0.75 — A third variable as each point’s area.<br>`density-bin-chart` 0.6 — Counts per bin when points overlap.<br>`connected-scatter-chart` 0.5 — When the points have an order.<br>`polar-scatter-chart` 0.3 — When one variable is an angle. | rows>500: `density-bin-chart` +0.35 — Hundreds of points read better as counts per bin.<br>rows>500: `scatter-chart` -0.2 — Points overplot and hide their density.<br>values>2: `bubble-chart` +0.2 — A third numeric field can size the points. |
| `points` | `distribution` | `density-bin-chart` 0.85 — Points counted in hexagonal or square bins.<br>`contour-chart` 0.8 — Iso-lines of the density.<br>`scatter-chart` 0.6 — Every point, when there are few.<br>`polar-scatter-chart` 0.4 — Points by angle and radius. |  |
| `points` | `change` | `connected-scatter-chart` 0.9 — An ordered path through x-y points: how two values moved together. |  |
| `points` | `network` | `delaunay-chart` 0.85 — Neighbours by triangulation, or each point’s Voronoi cell. |  |
| `points` | `compare` | `bubble-chart` 0.7 — Positions and sizes compared at once. |  |
| `distribution` | `distribution` | `histogram-chart` 0.9 — Observations binned in the core.<br>`box-plot-chart` 0.8 — Quartiles, median, whiskers and outliers.<br>`violin-chart` 0.75 — The density’s shape, mirrored.<br>`beeswarm-chart` 0.7 — Every observation, packed without overlap.<br>`ecdf-chart` 0.65 — The cumulative share below each value.<br>`wind-rose` 0.3 — When the observations carry a bearing. | rows<30: `beeswarm-chart` +0.25 — Few observations: show each one.<br>rows<30: `histogram-chart` -0.2 — Few observations make coarse bins.<br>rows>1000: `beeswarm-chart` -0.4 — Too many observations to draw one by one. |
| `distribution` | `compare` | `box-plot-chart` 0.9 — Quartiles side by side, one box per group.<br>`violin-chart` 0.85 — Density shapes side by side.<br>`ridgeline-chart` 0.8 — Densities on overlapping baselines, one per group.<br>`ecdf-chart` 0.75 — Cumulative curves of each group on one axis. |  |
| `distribution` | `change` | `ridgeline-chart` 0.85 — A density per period, stacked in order. |  |
| `intervals` | `uncertainty` | `error-bar-chart` 0.9 — A point estimate with its interval per category.<br>`range-band-chart` 0.85 — A band between low and high over x. |  |
| `intervals` | `trend` | `range-band-chart` 0.85 — The band between low and high over time.<br>`candlestick-chart` 0.8 — Open, high, low and close per period. |  |
| `intervals` | `change` | `candlestick-chart` 0.9 — Each period’s open-to-close change and its range. |  |
| `intervals` | `schedule` | `interval-chart` 0.95 — Floating bars from start to end on lanes. |  |
| `events` | `schedule` | `activity-grid` 0.85 — One cell per day, a column per week. |  |
| `events` | `trend` | `activity-grid` 0.8 — Activity per day over weeks. |  |
| `single` | `kpi` | `kpi-card` 0.9 — The figure, its delta and its trend.<br>`gauge-arc` 0.75 — A percent on a 240° arc.<br>`meter-chart` 0.7 — A percent with a needle. |  |
| `single` | `progress` | `gauge-arc` 0.85 — An arc swept to the percent done.<br>`meter-chart` 0.8 — A needle at the percent done. |  |
| `field` | `flow` | `vector-field-chart` 0.95 — An arrow per grid point, its direction and magnitude. |  |
| `field` | `distribution` | `contour-chart` 0.85 — Iso-lines and bands of a scalar grid (`source: 'grid'`). |  |

## Common chart props

Every chart takes these, under the same names in React, Vue and Angular.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | `readonly Datum[]` |  | Rows to draw. If omitted, the demo dataset is rendered (REQ-093): accessor props (`…Key`, `keys`, `names`, `levels`, `axis`, `dimensions`, `period`, `nodes`) are ignored, every other prop applies. |
| `ground` | `GroundRef` | `'silverpoint'` | Style ground. Defaults to the app provider's, or `silverpoint`. |
| `substrate` | `SubstrateName` | `'cream'` | Prepared substrate within the ground (REQ-046). |
| `mode` | `InkMode` | `'ink'` | `ink` by default; `precision` disables inking (REQ-021). |
| `palette` | `Palette` |  | Colours over the ground's, field by field, written on the root's `style` (REQ-461). Merged over the dashboard's and the provider's (REQ-462); presets are on `@silverpoint/core/palettes`. |
| `seed` | `Seed` |  | Seed. If omitted, it is derived from `id` stably (REQ-003). |
| `id` | `string` |  | Stable identifier. If omitted, it is generated deterministically. |
| `height` | `number` | `160` | Height of the drawing area in px. Width is the container's unless pinned. |
| `width` | `number` |  |  |
| `chrome` | `'card' \| 'bare'` | `'card'` | `card` draws the full frame; `bare` only the drawing area (REQ-095). |
| `hatchFill` | `'tile' \| 'per-shape'` | `'tile'` | How areas are filled (REQ-029). |
| `title` | `string` |  |  |
| `badge` | `string` |  |  |
| `value` | `string \| number` |  |  |
| `unit` | `string` |  |  |
| `footerLeft` | `string` |  |  |
| `footerRight` | `string` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name. If omitted, it is derived from `title` (REQ-120). |
| `description` | `string` |  | Long description for screen readers (REQ-120). |
| `dataTable` | `'visible' \| 'hidden' \| 'none'` | `'hidden'` | Tabular alternative; `hidden` leaves it for assistive technology only (REQ-121). |
| `locale` | `string` |  |  |
| `numberFormat` | `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

Defaults to know:

- `height` is 160, the drawing area without the card frame.
- `chrome` is `card`. `bare` drops the frame.
- `dataTable` is `hidden`: the table stays in the page for screen readers only.
- `hatchFill` is `tile`. `per-shape` traces the hatching shape by shape, which costs 10 to 40 times
  the path weight, so keep it for a hero chart or an export.

## Events

| React | Vue | Angular | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|
| `onActiveChange` | `@active-change` | `(activeChange)` | the item under the pointer or keyboard focus, or `null` |
| `onSelect` | `@select` | `(select)` | the item clicked or chosen with Enter or Space |
| `onRootChange` | `@root-change` | `(rootChange)` | the sunburst's or treemap's new root id, `null` for the data root |
